comment: Companion Windows LAPS policy for creating/managing the custom local administrator account
'x3nc0n'. The adopted LAPS-Shell Settings Catalog policy sets AdministratorAccountName but
manual LAPS mode does not create custom accounts; Microsoft documents that Automatic Account
Management is required for Windows LAPS to create/manage a custom account automatically.
These are documented LAPS CSP OMA-URI nodes, avoiding unverified Settings Catalog definition IDs.
Automatic Account Management requires Windows 11 24H2 or later (or Windows Server 2025+).
Older Windows builds should ignore/skip these nodes and will still need the account created by
another supported mechanism before the LAPS-Shell password settings can manage it.
No password is stored in git; Windows LAPS creates/rotates and backs up the secret to Entra ID.
name: laps-shell-automatic-account-management
